title: Fix remaining ABS silent catch blocks — add logging per Rule E-3
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-WEB-001/002

Three silent `catch { /* best-effort ... */ }` blocks remain in `AgentBackgroundService.cs` with zero logging:
- Line ~684: `catch { /* best-effort cleanup */ }` in disconnect exhaustion path
- Line ~1630: `catch { /* best-effort; fall through to player pos */ }` in HandleChatEventAsync entity parsing
- Line ~3659: `catch { /* best-effort parse */ }` in PushStatusToDashboardAsync entity parsing

Also one in `Program.cs` line ~601 for entity JSON parsing in `/api/agent/status`.

**Recommendation:** Replace each with `logger.LogWarning(ex, ...)` with contextual message per AGENTS.md Rule E-3.
